note: Reviewed document held in place by camera-source-ledger.test.mjs. Rights are a quoted line read from the operator's own page on the date shown, or exactly "unverified". Coverage is the camera count in the committed seed (or the PR head for pending rows), never a state bounding box. lastQualified is the build date of the committed seed (the last time the source was fetched and passed the build's gates), not a fresh probe. captureTime is "yes" only for a source whose adapter maps a real capture time into capturedAt through parseIsoTime (snapshot schema 2 can carry it); today none does, so every row is "no". The purpose set has no fire value: HPWREN and AlertWest are fire-detection networks and are filed under science.
